# M6.1 recorded decisions (human-reviewed)

**Status:** Binding for M6.1. **ADR-016 Accepted.** **Implementation COMPLETE AND VALIDATED** (C1–C7 on `cursor/m6.1-learner-ownership`). Final validation PASS. Ready for atomic commit. **M6.2 NOT STARTED.**

This file records human-reviewed answers. It is not executable. Adopted answers below are unchanged from ADR-016 acceptance.

**ADR-016** is **Accepted** in [`docs/architecture-baseline.md`](architecture-baseline.md) §20 ([ADR-016](architecture-baseline.md#adr-016--organization-scoped-learner-and-goal-ownership)). Do not edit ADR-002, ADR-005, ADR-013, ADR-014, or ADR-015 Decision rows.

## Adopted answers

| # | Decision | Answer |
|---|----------|--------|
| 1 | Learner model | **Model C.** Learner is an organization-scoped learning identity linked to a User. |
| 2 | Isolation | Learning is **isolated per organization**. A User may have a distinct Learner in each Organization. |
| 3 | Uniqueness | **UNIQUE `(organization_id, user_id)`** on Learner. |
| 4 | User vs Learner | **User ≠ Learner.** |
| 5 | Membership | OrganizationMembership remains affiliation/authorization. It is **not** the Learner entity. |
| 6 | Ownership root | **Goal** is the ownership root of the persisted learning journey. |
| 7 | Goal FKs | Owned Goals will carry **`organization_id` + `learner_id`** (same tenant). |
| 8 | Legacy rows | Existing M4 Goal rows must **not** receive fabricated owners. |
| 9 | Nullability | Legacy Goal ownership FKs are initially **nullable**. |
| 10 | Unowned access | Tenant-aware APIs **fail closed** for unowned legacy learning objects. |
| 11 | Path / Step / Evidence | Ownership **derived through Goal**. No `organization_id` / `learner_id` on those tables in the first M6 slice. |
| 12 | Session | AuthSession remains **User-only**. Never `sessions.organization_id` or `sessions.learner_id`. |
| 13 | OrganizationContext | Remains **request-scoped** (ADR-015). |
| 14 | LearnerContext | Derived **server-side** from authenticated User + validated OrganizationContext. Client `learnerId` is never authority. |
| 15 | Confirm / generate | Existing public confirm/generate routes **remain public** in the first M6 slice. |
| 16 | Golden Reference | **Unchanged** (UI, localStorage, E2E; no GR login; no dual-write in M6.1). |

## Out of M6.1

Path/Evidence persist HTTP, Program, Cohort, Mastery, invitations, Learner-before-User, full RBAC, Golden Reference integration, SSO/IdP, membership UI, authentication redesign, session org/learner columns.
